description: Works out arithmetic exactly from the figures sent: a short expression of figures, + − × ÷, brackets and % (such as 3 × 92 + 2 × 34.25 + 89.40), read by a parser and never run as code; or a list of figures, each with its unit and what it is, and one operation: sum, difference, product, quotient, percentage (the first figure as a % of the second), percent change or average. For X% of Y write X% * Y in the expression; X + Y% adds Y% of X, as a calculator does (8420 + 17.5% is 9893.50). Every step is exact, and the result is rounded once by its unit: dollars to the cent (half a cent up), percentages to two decimals. With compare_to, the result says its difference from that figure and whether they match, as for a printed invoice total. Figures in different units aren't added together, and a division by zero, a percentage of zero or a percent change from zero comes back as an error. Returns the result with its unit, how it was worked out, the figures it came from and the result as it's said aloud. Nothing about the request is stored or counted.

anyOf.description: A figure the result is checked against, such as a printed total.
A short arithmetic expression: figures, + - * / (or x and ÷), brackets and %, such as 3 * 92 + 2 * 34.25. Sent instead of operation and values.

With values: sum, difference (the first minus the rest), product, quotient (the first ÷ the second), percentage (the first as a % of the second), percent_change (from the first to the second) or average.
The result's unit when the figures don't carry one, such as dollars.
The figures for the operation, in order.
What it is, such as line 1 or last month's sales.
Its unit, such as dollars, percent, lb, oz, hours or cases.

anyOf.description: For a percent change: the change itself, in the figures' unit.

words.description: The comparison in words, such as 17.15 less than 451.05.

anyOf.description: How a figure was read, such as 18% as 0.18.

exact.description: The exact result, to six decimals when it repeats.

repeats.description: True when the exact result is a repeating decimal, cut at six decimals.

value.description: The result, rounded by its unit's rule.

shown.description: The result with its unit, as written: $433.90, 9.52%.

spoken.description: The result as it's said aloud, rounded the way people say it.

worked.description: How it was worked out, every figure as given.
